data.gender_notes: Inbisat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Inbisat is an Arabic name for a girl, which means 'Gift of Paradise'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Inbi' meaning 'Gift' and 'Sat' meaning 'Paradise'. It reflects the idea of a precious and divine gift that is bestowed upon a child. The name Inbisat carries the meaning “Gift of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Inbisat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Inbisat is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the blessings and gifts that come from Allah (God), and the idea that every child is a precious gift from Him. It also reminds us of the beauty and abundance of Paradise, and the hope that we can strive to live a life that is worthy of entering it.
data.etymology: Inbisat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Inbisat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
